prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Deliver one original polished square app icon called Watchful Husky: a friendly blue-grey cartoon husky HEAD ONLY, facing front with a subtle inquisitive head tilt. Two upright triangular ears, a clean warm-white husky facial mask and cheeks, a small dark nose, calm alert eyes and a slight knowing closed-mouth smile. Expression is warm, reassuring, gently mischievous, mature rather than babyish or fierce. No body, no paws, NO TAIL, no key, no keyhole, no padlock, no shield, no collar, no props, no motion strokes, no wording. Shape: compact bold recognizable dog-head silhouette with restrained geometric fur points and a strong ear outline; readable at 40 pixels. Clean flat vector-like mascot illustration, broad shapes, minimal shading and outlines, no fine fur texture, no glossy large anime eyes, no elaborate reflections. Palette slate blue grey #748DA6, dark slate #435B75, warm cream-white #FFF4DE, solid uniform deep plum background #241E32. Center the head optically at about 72 to 76 percent of the canvas with ample margins around ear tips and cheeks. Opaque edge-to-edge square image; do NOT round the outer corners or add a border. Original character, no recognizable existing cartoon husky, movie Balto, or software dog mascot. Concept will be used as an alternate app icon in a personal photo vault beta.
